svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.16.1.3 Required Floors-on-Ground
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.16 FLOORS-ON-GROUND

g.text: Floor-on-ground provided: access to the space,
no floor supported by the structure
A floor supported by the structure:
Floor supported by the structure, Clause (1)(b)

svg.text: All spaces within dwelling units, except crawl
spaces, are provided with a floor-on-ground
(a) access is provided to the space, and (b) a
floor supported by the structure is not provided.
Drawn: spaces in a dwelling unit cut through. Sizes are illustration only.
